correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the third-iterate fixed state corresponds bijectively to three successive temporal rows. Rule54 update forces parity of each column equal to the OR of neighboring row bits. Either parity zero everywhere yields uniform-zero history, or parity one everywhere requires columns 001,010,100,111, and defect columns cannot occupy spatial sites distance two. Converse reconstructs exact R^3 fixed states. Three independent one-hot colors give polynomial H_n(w)=1+s_n(w) for odd n, 1+s_(n/2)(w)^2 for even n, s0=2,s1=1,s_m=s_(m-1)+3w*s_(m-2). This yields (H_n(1)-2)/3 primitive temporal three-orbits and entropy log((1+sqrt13)/2). Independent brute-force rings n3..8 yielded 11,50,62,101,338,962 fixed states; analytical bijection proves all n.
